title: GPT-6 Astra Beats MolmoAct 2 in RoboColosseum Robot Tests
summary:
Allen AI's MolmoAct 2 model finished as the runner-up to GPT-6 Astra in a series of real-world robotics tests focused on a Franka robot arm. The MolmoAct 2 model completed the designated evaluations on the RoboColosseum platform without requiring additional training specifically for those tasks.

The testing platform is an open evaluation initiative launched by Hugging Face in partnership with BitRobotNetwork, eaic_sg, and DJiafei to provide a standardized environment for robotic AI verification. The project offers 10,000 free evaluation hours and grants access to more than 100 robots and 140 in-the-wild scenes, with all rollout and failure data published to the Hugging Face Hub.
